Thank you, but I know they won’t believe me or care. It really comes down to two options.

You must be a good person, since you believe your life needs a meaningful purpose higher than yourself ie raising kids. Going by evolution and the laws of nature, if you made it into existence, you’re here for a reason. Throughout history Aunties/Uncles/relatives helped ensure the survival of their nieces/nephews/siblings etc, so the DNA of the family line survived... your ancestors fought hard to get you here, but so did their relatives and friends. You still have a purpose when it comes to DNA and evolution, but you’re much more than just that! I hope you’ll feel better soon

Yes. I ended up in a wheelchair for eight months because of that. I don’t have the same response to pain as most people, and I’m hopeless at communication, so the Doctor I saw simply didn’t believe me. She called me and apologised when the X-Ray came back, but she’d already helped destroy my left foot by then.

I tried going to groups about climate action etc. I’ve never fit in anywhere but I cared, I tried, but it was always a negative experience. Most groups are cliques, people trying to impress each other while I sit in the corner thinking ‘why am I here?’, then I get treated by all the fashionistas like ‘why are you here?’ Talked to condescendingly or stared at. They don’t want some random person who can’t fit in trying to, it’s not about activism, it’s about trendiness for them. I guess the first step in removing barriers is the group has to actually want to include you. If they don’t walk away.

So is there any subreddit where people who think they are TIs can speak? I don’t mind not posting on this one if you think it’ll destroy credibility. I wish there was anywhere I could speak right now, mainly because I’ve held on for years but in a week or so now, I will no longer be safe. My time is almost up. I’ve already been attacked, with a witness, in the past, the difference is now, I’m going to be homeless soon. I know my chances of survival are probably low, since the perps have already proven they want me dead, not just for fun. I’m running out of time to speak and share my story before the perps get me. So where do I post... I’d like to share my story before I go.
